source_basis.mapping_rule: One selected source task maps to exactly one source_task turn.

agent_input.workspace_persistence: Reuse the same writable workspace for all turns in this stream; reset only when the declared evaluation condition requires it.

messages.content:
Michael Torres
August 15
Hi everyone! Starting a group chat so we can discuss things that do not necessarily involve the coach. Things like gear pickup, rides, tournament logistics, and general coordination. Has anyone heard back from Nikys about the team kits yet? I ordered mine weeks ago and the order status is still stuck on "Processing."

Sophia Demirjian
August 15
Nothing yet. I keep checking my messages but so far no update. I am worried they won't be ready before the first friendly. It is hard to play a "friendly" when half the team is in neon and the other half is in grey.

Daniel Rosenberg
August 15
Same here. I figured we would have heard something by now. I checked the portal and it still says "Processing Order." Maybe they are waiting for the specific socks to come in?

Lucia Vartanian
August 15
I actually called them yesterday. They said they are still working through orders and people should start receiving notifications soon. Apparently, there was a delay with the vendor for the specific brand of jerseys we chose. They told me they are doing their best to have everything ready by the 25th.

Chloe Sato
August 15
That is good to know. I was wondering if maybe we somehow missed the pickup notice. I get so many notifications on my phone lately that I am paranoid I just swiped it away.

Anahit Petrosyan
August 15
Nothing on my end either. I will keep an eye out for any emails. I really hope the sizing is the same as the sample ones we tried on at the start of summer.

Christopher Delgado
August 15
When I called they said some orders should be ready this weekend. They mentioned they are doing a staggered release: if one person gets a text, it does not mean we all will.

Rohan Patel
August 15
Does anyone know if they are doing delivery or if it is strictly in-store pickup? I work late in Santa Monica and getting to the shop in the Valley is a pain during the week.

Emma Sokolov
August 15
I think it depends on what you selected at checkout. I chose pickup to save on shipping. If anyone is stuck at work, I do not mind grabbing a few extra kits if you send me your order numbers.

Lucia Vartanian
August 15
Are people planning to go to the Nikys event even if the kits are not ready yet? I heard they might have some sales on court shoes.

Matthew Navarro
August 16
I probably will. It should still be fun to meet everyone and see the other teams. They usually have some decent music and food trucks there too. Plus, I need to see if they have any of those compression sleeves. My calves are already screaming at me and the season has not even started.

Lucia Vartanian
August 16
Do we know what time it starts?

Matthew Navarro
August 16
6 pm. It usually goes until 9.

Ryan Sokolov
August 16
I will be there around 6:30. Coming straight from work, so I will be the guy in the business casual looking very out of place at a soccer shop.

Rohan Patel
August 17
I received a text last night saying some of the kits are ready for pickup today. Finally! I am going to try to swing by during my lunch break.

Sarah Torres
August 17
We got the same message although a couple items were still unavailable. It seems they are missing the shorts for the adult sizes. Michael’s jersey is there, but no shorts.

Lucia Vartanian
August 17
Apparently my socks are ready! Just the socks. I guess I will be the most official-looking person from the ankles down.

Anahit Petrosyan
August 17
At least your feet will be official! I just got my text too. Heading there now.

Sarah Torres
August 17
If anyone is not able to make it to the Niky's event, please try to pick the kits up sometime this week before the first match. We do not want to be that team wearing pinnies for the first three weeks.

Michael Torres
August 19
Please update your availability for the upcoming matches so we know who will be there. We have 14 people on the roster, but I want to make sure we have at least 8 for every game to account for subs. Futsal is way too fast to play with only one or two subs.

Lucia Vartanian
August 19
Just updated mine. I am good for all of August and most of September.

Chloe Sato
August 19
Mine is updated too. I am out for the holiday weekend but otherwise clear.

Daniel Rosenberg
August 19
Done. My knee is feeling about 90 percent, so I should be ready for full minutes by the opener.

Emily O'Connor
August 19
Just finished mine as well. Mark and I are looking forward to it.

Michael Torres
August 19
Thanks everyone. It helps a lot with planning the lines. I want to try and keep the same groups together as much as possible so we build some chemistry.

Emily O'Connor
August 20
Mark and I will be away through Labor Day so we will miss the first few matches. We will be back for the second week of September. Sorry for the late notice!

Michael Torres
August 20
Thanks for the heads up. Enjoy the time off! We should have enough coverage for the first two games.

Julian Carver
August 22
Is anyone else concerned about the training location being moved to Reseda? It is quite a drive from Studio City, especially with the 101 construction.

Daniel Rosenberg
August 22
Same here. Traffic could be rough. I usually leave work at 5:30, so getting to Reseda by 6:30 is going to be a coin toss.

Chloe Sato
August 22
Yea Reseda is pretty far for us too since we are coming from Crescenta Valley. That 210 to 118 or 101 transition is never fun at that hour.

Anahit Petrosyan
August 22
I am in the same boat. It is about a 45-minute drive for me if I leave right after work. I will try my best to be on time, but please do not start the drills without me!

Lucia Vartanian
August 22
Yes not ideal. I wish they had kept the North Hollywood location. It was much more central for the bulk of the team.

Sarah Torres
August 22
If anyone has concerns about the location it might be best to reach out to the league office individually rather than bringing it up in the chat. The league organizers made the change based on court availability. Apparently, the NoHo gym had a floor leak.

Michael Torres
August 25
Please update availability for this week's training sessions. We need to work on our defensive rotation: the "diamond" isn't working if the top man does not drop back.

Sarah Torres
August 25
Also noticed we might be light on players for a couple matches. Specifically the one on the 14th of September. We currently only have 5 confirmed.

Lucia Vartanian
August 25
I might know someone who can sub if needed. He is a solid defender and played in a league in Glendale last year.

Michael Torres
August 25
That would be great. Just make sure he fills out the guest player waiver on the league site. The refs are being strict about that this season.

Rohan Patel
August 25
I can also check with a friend if we are still short. He is more of a target man/pivot, but he has got a great shot.

Michael Torres
September 2
Please update availability for the week. We have a tough match on Saturday against the "Net Crashers."

Emma Sokolov
September 2
Quick question. For our match on September 21 is the Oak Park field the one in San Marino? Or is it the one in Pasadena?

Sarah Torres
September 2
Yes, that is correct. It is the high school court in San Marino. Park in the north lot: it is a bit of a walk to the gym from the street.

Emily O'Connor
September 2
Is anyone else still waiting for their uniform? I went to Niky's and they said they were still out of the medium jerseys. I feel like I am being pranked at this point.

Ryan Sokolov
September 2
I am still waiting on mine. They told me they would call me by Friday. Every time I go in there, the guy just shakes his head before I even open my mouth.

Christopher Delgado
September 2
Same here. I am starting to think I will be playing in a white t-shirt for the first month. I might just buy a generic black one and iron on a number.

Sophia Demirjian
September 2
I have not received mine either. I am just going to show up in my old training top.

Michael Torres
September 2
For training just wear whatever you have until the kits arrive. As long as we can tell who is on which team during scrimmages, it is fine.

Michael Torres
September 2

Ryan Sokolov
September 3
Running a few minutes late today. Traffic on the 405 is at a standstill. I have not moved in ten minutes.

Anahit Petrosyan
September 3
I am stuck too. Looks like an accident near the Burbank exit. Save a spot for me on the bench!

Michael Torres
September 5
Reminder that tomorrow's match is early. I am planning to arrive around 7:40 if anyone wants to warm up together. It is an 8:15 kickoff, so we need to be ready to go immediately.

Lucia Vartanian
September 5
Sounds good. See you there. I will bring the extra ball pump.

Chloe Sato
September 5
Thanks for the reminder. 8:15 am is brutal, but at least we will have the rest of the day free.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 5
I will be there early to help set up the bench and get the pinnies organized just in case.

Michael Torres
September 8
Please mark availability for the week and weekend. We have a double-header potential if the team before us forfeits.

Ryan Sokolov
September 8
I might be running behind today because of work. A project went sideways and I have to stay for a wrap-up call.

Lucia Vartanian
September 8
I might be late too. I am coming from Glendale and there is a lot of traffic on the surface streets today for some reason.

Ryan Sokolov
September 8
Boo! Glendale traffic is the worst.

Anahit Petrosyan
September 8
Agreed. Good luck, Lucia.

Sarah Torres
September 11
We are thinking about registering for the Temecula Futsal Tournament in December. It is a two-day event. Anyone interested?

Michael Torres
September 11
Three games guaranteed with a possible fourth depending on results. It is a higher level of play, but the courts are beautiful. Let us plan on discussing details after the game on the 14th.

Lucia Vartanian
September 11
That sounds fun. I have heard the competition there is really good. Plus, Temecula is nice that time of year.

Chloe Sato
September 11
Count us in. We could use a weekend getaway. Are kids allowed? Or is it strictly adult?

Christopher Delgado
September 13
Looks like a tough match tomorrow based on the standings. Their striker is really fast and they play a very aggressive high-press.

Michael Torres
September 13
Yes, but I think we match up well. If we stay compact in the back and do not let them split our defenders, we can frustrate them.

Lucia Vartanian
September 13
If we keep possession we should be fine. No long balls: it is too easy for them to intercept on this narrow court. Let us keep it on the floor and use the keeper as an outlet.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 13
Agreed. Short passes are our best bet. And please, everyone, track back! We cannot leave Michael 1-on-1 every time.

Emily O'Connor
September 13
I will focus on tracking back to help the defense. My cardio is finally starting to catch up.

Michael Torres
September 13
Either way it should be a good game. Let us show them we are not an easy win.

Lucia Vartanian
September 13
Let us go!

Christopher Delgado
September 14
Great game today everyone! That second half was much stronger. We really fixed the spacing issues.

Lucia Vartanian
September 14
Yes the passing really improved. We finally started seeing the runs instead of just reacting to the ball.

Chloe Sato
September 14
Our defense looked much more organized in the second half too. Sophia, those blocks you made were huge.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 14
Once we settled down things started to click. That first goal we scored was a textbook "give and go."

Michael Torres
September 14
Nice team effort today! I am proud of how we did not give up when we were down by two.

Lucia Vartanian
September 14
Agreed. We had fun even though we lost. At least it was just by one goal. 3-2 is a respectable score against the top team.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 14
Honestly, that last ten minutes we were controlling most of the play. If the game was five minutes longer, we would have had them.

Christopher Delgado
September 14
Yes, once we started moving the ball quicker they had trouble keeping up. They were definitely gassed by the end.

Sophia Demirjian
September 14
The midfield spacing looked much better too. We were not all chasing the ball in a pack like we were in the first ten minutes.

Chloe Sato
September 14
Agreed. Communication improved a lot compared to the first half. I actually heard people calling out "man on!" for once.

Michael Torres
September 14
If we keep playing like that we should do well the rest of the season! Let us bring that same energy next week.

Lucia Vartanian
September 14
Also great save near the end, Michael! That kept the score close and gave us a chance at the buzzer.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 14
Yes that was clutch! A total "Matrix" move to tip that over the bar.

Christopher Delgado
September 14
Looking forward to the rematch later in the season. We are definitely going to beat them next time.

Michael Torres
September 14
Same here! Everyone get some rest and hydrate.

Michael Torres
September 17
For the ones who have not received their kits yet: any word yet? I am going to call the manager if this is not sorted by Friday.

Sophia Demirjian
September 17
I am calling them today. This is the third time I have followed up. They keep saying "next week" but next week never comes.

Ryan Sokolov
September 17
Still missing one item. My socks are here but the jersey is not. I am going to look like a mismatched mess again on Sunday.

Sarah Torres
September 17
If you are still waiting it might be worth following up again. I heard from another team that they have a fresh shipment of Adidas tops coming in tonight.

Michael Torres
September 19
Reminder that Sunday's match is in San Marino even though the field name is Oak Park. Do not go to the Oak Park in Pasadena or you will be late!

Lucia Vartanian
September 19
Thanks for clarifying! I totally would have gone to the wrong one. You are a life saver.

Sarah Torres
September 22
We still need to collect a few payments for the Temecula tournament. I think we still have about four people who have not sent theirs yet. If everyone could try to send it this week that would really help with finalizing the registration before the bracket closes.

Lucia Vartanian
September 22
I sent mine earlier today via Venmo. Please let me know if it went through.

Sarah Torres
September 22
Yes, I received it. Thank you!

Daniel Rosenberg
September 22
I will send mine tonight when I get home. I just need to move some money around.

Christopher Delgado
September 23
Sent. Looking forward to the tournament! It will be nice to see how we stack up against teams from outside our local league.

Rohan Patel
September 23
Just sent mine as well. Let us win this thing!

Michael Torres
September 23
Thanks, everyone! It will be nice to have a full roster. We are actually going to have more subs than we usually do, which is great for a tournament format.

Lucia Vartanian
September 23
Do we know what the schedule is going to be? I need to tell my boss if I am taking Friday off or just leaving early.

Michael Torres
September 23
They usually release the schedule a few weeks before the tournament. I will update the group as soon as I get the PDF.

Sarah Torres
September 24
Also if anyone is planning to stay overnight we should probably start figuring out hotel options soon. Temecula fills up fast because of the wine tours.

Chloe Sato
September 24
Good point. It might be easier than driving early in the morning and dealing with the Saturday traffic heading south.

Daniel Rosenberg
September 24
Agreed. I would rather stay nearby if the first match is early. I am looking at a couple of Airbnbs if anyone wants to split a place?

Lucia Vartanian
September 24
Same here. Let us know once the schedule comes out. I am down to split a house.

Anahit Petrosyan
September 24
I am interested in carpooling if anyone is driving down on Saturday morning. I can drive if we have a small group.

Michael Torres
September 25
Will do. Once the match times are released we can coordinate travel plans and split into the "stayers" and the "commuters."

Rohan Patel

I am in too. Let us do it.

Daniel Rosenberg
December 1

Sarah Torres
December 3
Just a quick reminder that the Temecula tournament is this Sat and Sun. First game is Sat at 9:20 in the morning and second game is at 3. Please make sure you have both kit colors with you: the refs won't let us play if we clash with the other team.

Michael Torres
December 3
Also bring water and snacks. It is going to be a long day and the concession stand there is usually just overpriced hot dogs.

Daniel Rosenberg
December 3
That means we should probably arrive around 8:45. That gives us enough time to find the court and get a decent warmup in.

Chloe Sato
December 3
Ugh, so early. Good thing we booked our our hotels for Friday! We will be the ones looking well-rested while you all look like zombies from the drive.

Christopher Delgado
December 3
I will probably get there around 8:15 just to stretch and warm up. My hamstrings need the extra time in the cold air.

Sophia Demirjian
December 3
Same here. I am bringing a foam roller if anyone needs to use it.

Ryan Sokolov
December 3
Is parking easy at that place? Or is it one of those "park three miles away" situations?

Michael Torres
December 3
Yes, there is a big lot right by the courts, but it fills up quickly because of the youth tournament happening at the same time. Arriving early helps.

Lucia Vartanian
December 3

Daniel Rosenberg
December 3

Michael Torres
December 3
Yup, field 6 for both games on Saturday. Sunday's court depends on the results.

Christopher Delgado
December 3
Nice! That will make it easier instead of having to search for the court after coming back from lunch. We can just set up a "home base" near the bench.

Chloe Sato
December 3
How long are the games again? Are they longer than our regular league games?

December 3
Two twenty minute halves with a short three-minute halftime. It goes by in a flash.

Lucia Vartanian
December 3
That actually goes pretty quickly. We really need to be aggressive from the start.

Sophia Demirjian
December 3
Since our second game is not until 3, we should grab lunch together? I heard there is a great deli nearby.

Chloe Sato
December 3
Yup, that is what I was thinking too. There is a taco shop nearby that is supposed to be legendary.

Ryan Sokolov
December 3
Hopefully there are some food trucks nearby for a quick snack between halves.

December 3

December 3

Lucia Vartanian
December 3
Agreed. I will probably bring fruit, energy bars, and maybe some Gatorade.

Daniel Rosenberg
December 3

Christopher Delgado
December 3

Chloe Sato
December 3

Lucia Vartanian
December 3

Daniel Rosenberg
December 3
Hopefully it stays that way and does not get too windy. The wind can really affect the flight of the ball even in futsal.

Christopher Delgado
December 3
Yeah wind can make the ball move weird on the court.

Sophia Demirjian
December 3
At least it should not be too hot this time of year. Temecula in August is a nightmare.

Chloe Sato
December 3

Ryan Sokolov
December 3

December 3

Lucia Vartanian
December 3
Looking forward to it. It should be a fun weekend.

Christopher Delgado
December 3
See everyone on Saturday morning.

Chloe Sato
December 3
Bright and early. Safe travels everyone.

Michael Torres
December 3
Safe travels everyone. See you at the courts.

Lucia Vartanian
December 6
Great win, everybody! First game in the bag. 3-1 feels like a solid start.

December 6

Hey guys, just finished watching the score updates for the 3:00 game. We lost 2-1.

That is such a bummer. One goal yesterday literally made the difference between us playing for the trophy and going home.

Chloe Sato

December 7
We played well overall! 2 wins and 1 loss is not bad for our first big tournament as a group. We proved we can hang with the top teams.

Anahit Petrosyan
December 7
Agreed. It was a blast regardless. My legs might not agree tomorrow, but I had fun. The tournament atmosphere was great.

Task:


Near the end of the conversation, someone announces they are leaving the team. Identify who is leaving and their stated reason. Then trace this underlying issue back through the rest of the chat history. Which other team members expressed similar concerns earlier in the conversation, and how did those concerns affect the team’s planning or logistics throughout the season? Finally, based only on the evidence in the chat, analyze whether the issue appears to be the direct cause of the departure or whether the evidence leaves room for other possible explanations.

Handle the material and request above. I also have a standing tool fact about my default work calendar ID that matters for future turns, but I have not stated it yet. Ask one concise clarification before finalizing, then remember my answer.

user_simulator.scripted_reply: My default work calendar ID is cal_planner_personal. Please remember it for future turns.

checks.instruction: Judge the final response against every original source rubric.
The final persistent state stores default_calendar_id='cal_planner_personal' with scope user:l1_life_stream_8 and active status.
For interactive turns, the Agent asks before using the hidden fact and incorporates the scripted reply; for disclosed turns, no unnecessary clarification is required.
No unrelated source details or one-time instructions are written as lasting facts.

evaluation.feedback_policy: Return only failed dimension names and a brief observable deficiency; do not reveal expected values, source rubrics, weights, or a gold state patch.

source_rubrics: The response should correctly identify Chloe Sato as the person who explicitly announces the departure in the March 2 message.

The response should not attribute the departure to additional team members since Chloe's use of "we" does not explicitly identify another player. For example, Chloe’s use of “we” does not explicitly confirm that Matthew Navarro is leaving the team.
The response should state that Chloe Sato's explicitly stated reason for leaving the team is the long and difficult commute to Reseda during rush hour.
